_comment: Placeholder dialogue. 'shot' per line: two | dude | bot | phone. 'events' anchor things to a word of the line: a cut to the phone insert, a chat message on the phone, a stamp, a sound. 'word' matches the start of a word (case-insensitive). 'voice' is an optional WAV take; without it build_audio.py makes placeholder babble with exact word timings.
